data.narrative:
Beyond Reach Labs is a pre-seed stage space and aerospace company founded by Mitchell Fogelson and Pele Collins that has raised $500K to date, with an additional $175M+ in letters of intent. The valuation universe encompasses 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given data constraints. Stage-progression analysis uses the $500K raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of pre-seed to next-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $1.25M. Peer-median analysis could not proceed; while 11 same-sector peers exist, none met minimum threshold (≥3 datapoints) within same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters. Public-comp anchoring was infeasible absent the target's revenue figure, though the sector P/S median across public comps stands at 23.9x.

The triangulation range is $1.06M to $1.44M, with a median of $1.25M. This analysis carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the absence of comparable pre-seed transactions in the narrow space and aerospace subset. The substantial letter-of-intent pipeline ($175M+) represents non-binding forward interest but does not inform current-stage valuation mechanics. Revenue disclosure or access to tightly matched pre-seed stage comps would meaningfully improve confidence.
